summary: Publish the durable LLM development optimization plan

delivery.outcome: Publish the durable optimization plan in canonical docs/refactoring and link it from the project documentation index.
nonGoals: Creating a competing wellmanifest/docs or wellmanifest/report standard
Moving raw logs, credentials, private receipts or full transcripts into the repository
Claiming external package publication, runtime deployment or fleet readiness
Changing active Taskand runtime behavior or the existing ticket-018 panel feature

architecture.decision: Keep the durable plan and index in Taskand while retaining private evidence outside checkout; leave Docs policy adoption to the dedicated governance ticket.
architecture.rollback: Revert the documentation/adoption commit while retaining the private content-addressed handoff; do not delete recovery evidence.
